notes: SourceMapBuilder::add for every mapping, into_sourcemap, then to_writer into a Vec: the crate encodes the mappings only when writing JSON, so its result is JSON text.
details: The JavaScript entries return an object whose mappings field is the encoded string and do not write JSON. Here writing the file name, the source list and the name list as JSON is part of the call; it is a small share next to encoding the mappings.
